title: Major Odes of the Kingdom, Decade 1, Ode 4: The Yî Pho
note:
Stanzas 1 and 2 only, as Legge gives them.

In praise of king Wăn, celebrating his influence, dignity in the temple services, activity, and capacity to rule.

verses.t:
Abundant is the growth of the buckthorn and shrubby trees,
Supplying firewood; yea, stores of it.
Elegant and dignified was our prince and king;
On the left and the right they hastened to him.

Elegant and dignified was our prince and king;
On his left and his right they bore their half-mace (libation-cups):—
They bore them with solemn gravity,
As beseemed such eminent officers.
